rationale: The previous candidate further reduced base_speed to 1.1, increased ki to 1.0, and lowered kd to 2.0, but the slalom track still resulted in 0% finish rate due to stalling, and line loss events remain high. To address persistent stalling on the slalom track, I will reduce base_speed further to 0.9 to improve stability and prevent stalls. I will increase ki to 1.5 to enhance steady-state error correction, aiming to reduce rms_error and line loss events. Since steering oscillation may still be high, I will reduce kd to 1.0 to smooth steering and reduce overcorrection. The geometry and sensor layout remain unchanged as they have supported stable line tracking. The line loss strategy remains 'last_direction' as it has helped reduce stalls previously. I continue to request the same measurements to monitor completion, progress, errors, line loss, and steering oscillation. I expect these changes to improve finish rates on the slalom track by reducing stalls, lower rms_error and line loss events, and reduce steering oscillation for smoother control.
